sentences.text: Mr. Hardik Mehta, learned APP for the respondent - State has placed on record the report dated 21.06.2023 submitted by the Superintendent of Police, Kutch - Gandhidham, along with the report submitted by the surety of the convict for the release on parole leave, statement of the original complainant - Premilaben W/o.
Kanjibhai Sathwara has placed on record.
He has objected to grant of parole leave to the present applicant - convict.

2. On perusal of the jail remarks, it has transpired that the convict is imposed sentence of 10 years for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 363, 506 (2), 323 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
It further appears that the applicant was not released pending the trial and after the order of conviction, he has undergone period of 2 months and 12 months.
In view of the aforesaid brief period undergone by the applicant, this Court is not inclined to entertain present application.
